about: Claims about moments of the eval recordings, each labeled true or false off the frames, to measure the agent that checks a finding against the video (agent.js verifyClaims; eval/verifycheck.mjs). Labels come from full-size crops read by eye on Oct 22, or from the frame-read answer keys in eval/answer-keys/games. A claim is true only when every fact in it is. The regions are what the learn call boxed in a run that read the record right. player: who the review knows the player is (the name they confirmed, the character, a side the scoreboard showed). events: what the record holds, from the answer keys, for the false claims the checker plants itself.
